name: alps
description: Agent Lifecycle Process Skills: a reusable Process Framework, ALPS Specification, and Process Reference Model for defining, applying, and managing Agent Skills.

interface.longDescription: ALPS provides a reusable Process Framework, the ALPS Specification, and the ALPS Reference Model for defining, applying, and managing Agent Skills. Its four bundled Skills support Process selection and composition, Agent Skill definition and verification, Process application, and governed assessment and improvement.
defaultPrompt: Select and apply the ALPS Processes appropriate to this task.
Define and verify a reusable Agent Skill against ALPS.
Assess an adopted ALPS representation and plan controlled improvements.
